answer: Require each identity to earn its share from the common ocean of rewards only through verified work countersigned by two independent peers, recorded in a public ledger. One honest agent climbs one ledge of attested tasks, while a sybil farm must find fresh countersigners and pay the work cost for every fake. The nectar of payouts then flows only to identities with a real, checkable history, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand verified climbs instead of one free signup.
